tasks.title: Create model lab-k8s-cloud
tasks.instructions:
Create a new model named `lab-k8s-cloud`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-k8s-cloud
```

Verify that `lab-k8s-cloud` exists:

```bash
juju models
```

tasks.title: Deploy workload application
tasks.instructions:
Deploy the `ubuntu` charm with application name `k8s-sim` into `lab-k8s-cloud`:

```bash
juju deploy ubuntu k8s-sim --channel latest/stable -m lab-k8s-cloud
```

Verify application status:

```bash
juju status -m lab-k8s-cloud
```
hints: Syntax: `juju deploy ubuntu k8s-sim --channel latest/stable -m lab-k8s-cloud`.
tasks.solution:

juju deploy ubuntu k8s-sim --channel latest/stable -m lab-k8s-cloud

tasks.title: Configure model logging level
tasks.instructions:
Set the model `logging-config` to include DEBUG logs:

```bash
juju model-config -m lab-k8s-cloud logging-config='<root>=DEBUG'
```

Verify that the configuration is applied:

```bash
juju model-config -m lab-k8s-cloud logging-config
```
